recipe.title: One-Pot Cheesy Beef Protein Pasta
recipe.summary: Family-friendly protein pasta with lean beef, tomato sauce, chicken bone broth, mozzarella, and Parmesan.
recipe.story: This is the red-sauce pasta dinner everyone recognizes, made more filling with lean beef, protein pasta, and bone broth without making dinner feel like diet food.
ingredients: 3 cups Simple Truth Organic Chicken Bone Broth

ingredient_sections.title: Pasta and Sauce
items: 3 cups Simple Truth Organic Chicken Bone Broth

instructions: Heat a large deep skillet or Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the ground beef, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, pepper, and Italian seasoning. Cook for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking the beef into small pieces, until no pink remains.
Add the chicken bone broth and tomato sauce. Stir and bring to a gentle boil.
Stir in the dry penne. Reduce the heat to medium-low, cover, and cook for 12 to 14 minutes, stirring every 3 to 4 minutes so the pasta does not stick.
Remove the lid when the pasta is tender. Simmer uncovered for 2 to 3 minutes if extra liquid remains.
Turn off the heat. Stir in the mozzarella and Parmesan until melted.
Divide evenly into 6 servings of 1 1/2 cups each.
freezer_storage: Divide into individual portions. If four servings remain, use a gallon-size freezer bag. If fewer than four servings remain, use quart-size freezer bags.
Remove as much air as possible, seal, label, and freeze flat for up to 3 months.
reheating_instructions: Add 1 tablespoon chicken bone broth per serving and microwave for 90 seconds. Stir, then heat in 30-second intervals until the center reaches 165°F.
tips: Keep the heat at a gentle simmer after adding the pasta so the sauce stays in the pan instead of on the stove.
Measure each serving after the cheese is stirred through so the beef and pasta stay evenly distributed.
